text:
The main plate holds three pizza slices and a fish dish, probably sardines or mackerel fillets topped with grains and basil. The fruit on the side plate is probably not part of this plate, so I left it out.

Pizza: the slices look medium-sized.
- Tomato and onion slice: about 90 g, 220 kcal.
- Cheese slice: about 90 g, 230 kcal.
- Pepperoni or cheese slice: about 110 g, 290 kcal.
- Pizza total: about 290 g, 740 kcal.

Fish: about 3 fillets, roughly 150 g, with grains (wheat berries or barley) of about 60 g. The fish is about 250 kcal and the grains about 100 kcal, plus a little oil, so about 380 kcal for roughly 215 g.

Total is about 1120 kcal for about 505 g. I'll round to roughly 1100 kcal and 500 g.
